description: Bande-annonce de 30 s : une équipe invisible qui travaille de nuit pour une petite entreprise, montée épique, apogée, respiration finale.

sortie.style: Epic cinematic night, deep blue and warm orange contrast, volumetric light, anamorphic flares, slow heavy motion

plans.prompt: Epic wide aerial shot descending toward a sleeping city at night, thousands of lit windows, mist between towers, deep blue tones
Medium shot of a small workshop glowing warm orange in a dark street, empty chair at a workbench, tools neatly arranged, rain on the window

plans.resume: Flux de lumière entre les bureaux
plans.prompt: Abstract rivers of golden light flowing along a dark office corridor, papers lifting gently in the air, no people, cinematic haze
plans.camera: fast forward glide down the corridor

plans.resume: Détail : mains de nuit sur le clavier
plans.prompt: Extreme close-up of a keyboard lighting up key by key in the dark, reflections of soft blue light, no hands visible
Low-angle shot of a vast stone staircase with a stream of warm light climbing step by step toward a glowing doorway, dust motes, epic scale
Wide shot of the same workshop as sunrise floods the street, steam rising from the pavement, the window now glowing gold

plans.resume: Porte qui s'ouvre sur le matin
plans.prompt: Calm medium shot of a shop door opening onto a bright morning street, light spilling inside across the floor

musique: Orchestral électro sombre, percussions lourdes qui montent, grand impact à mi-film, résolution lumineuse
